Union Home Minister Amit Shah criticised the Congress over its November 1 rally, accusing Rahul Gandhi of being insensitive towards the Sikh community. Invoking the 1984 anti-Sikh riots, Shah questioned the Congress's position on the issue, adding to the political face-off between the BJP and the opposition ahead of the INDIA bloc rally in Delhi.
